title: Direct image of an extension gives the direct image torsor
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], $F$ an abelian sheaf on $Z_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ [def-sc-zariski-site, def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], and $0\to F\to E\xrightarrow{p}\mathbf Z_Z\to0$ a short exact sequence, where $\mathbf Z_Z$ is the constant integer sheaf. Its *fibre over $1$* is the sheaf $T=E\times_{\mathbf Z_Z,1}*$ of lifts of the global section $1$, with $F$ acting by translation. Define direct image by $(i_*A)(U)=A(U\cap Z)$ for open $U\subseteq X$, and let $u:\mathbf Z_X\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ restrict locally constant integer sections. The direct-image sequence $0\to i_*F\to i_*E\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z\to0$ is short exact [lem-sc-closed-immersion-pushforward-exact]. Its pullback along $u$ is the short exact sequence $0\to i_*F\to P\to\mathbf Z_X\to0$ with $P=i_*E\times_{i_*\mathbf Z_Z}\mathbf Z_X$. The fibre $P\times_{\mathbf Z_X,1}*$ is canonically the $i_*F$-torsor $i_*T$ [def-sc-gm-torsor].

source.place: Lemma 02UV and Lemma 02FQ: direct image along a closed immersion and the torsor fibre construction

proof.text: Use the underlying closed embedding directly. At a point i(z), Mathlib stalkPushforward_iso_of_isInducing identifies all three pushed-forward stalks with the original stalks; the germ formulas verify that both maps commute with these isomorphisms. Outside the closed image, restrict a germ representative to the complement of the image; its inverse image is empty and the sheaf has zero sections there, so every pushed-forward stalk is zero. Apply lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-short-exact-stalkwise to conclude short exactness.

source.place: Tag 01AX, proof by stalks; Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Stalks and Abelian

proof.text: Restrict the sheafification unit of the constant integer presheaf on Z along inverse-image opens. Its naturality gives a map of presheaves from the constant presheaf on X to the pushed-forward constant sheaf. The universal property of sheafification constructs r, and toSheafify_sheafifyLift proves the required formula on each integer section. Construct k as pullback.lift of the pushed-forward inclusion and zero. Its projections are the inclusion and zero. In an abelian category pullback.snd is epi since the original projection is epi, and k is mono since its composite with pullback.fst is mono. Exactness follows by applying exact_up_to_refinements to the first projection of any map killed by the second projection, then using pullback.hom_ext.

source.place: Tag 01AX and the pullback of an extension; Mathlib sheafification and abelian pullback universal properties

proof.text: First projection sends the pullback fibre over the restricted global section s to the pushforward fibre over q. The pullback equation and r(s)=q verify membership; naturality of first projection verifies restrictions. Apply sheafToPresheaf, evaluation, and forget to the pullback square. These preserve pullbacks. Types.ext_of_isPullback gives injectivity on the fibres, since both second projections are s. Types.exists_of_isPullback lifts (e,s), giving surjectivity. The resulting natural transformation is pointwise an isomorphism and hence yields a sheaf isomorphism whose value is first projection. For s=q=1, naturality of the constant presheaf sheafification unit gives r(s)=q on each open. Finally, lifts.vadd adds the kernel inclusion, so additivity of first projection and k followed by first projection equal to the pushed-forward inclusion prove the translation formula by Subtype.ext.
